docTitle: Kaartaan Geeshsha Mas'aafaa · Geeshsha Mas'aafaa Itti Xaaruwaan
metaDesc: Beni Caak'k'uwaa wode ogiyaa, Yesuusa de'uwaanne P'awuloosa buussaa tumu kaartaa bollan kaalla — Geeshsha Mas'aafay tumu sohotuwaan haneedda.

s.title: Kaartaan Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
s.verse: “Nuuni Aa wolk'k'aama bonchchuwaa nu ayfiyaan be'iide odettooppe attin, med'd'i akkeedda tossaan nu Godaa Kiristtoosa wolk'k'aanne yuussaa hinttenttoo odibeykko.” (2 P'eexiroosa 1:16)
s.purpose: Geeshsha Mas'aafay haysa gidenna. Hawe tumu sohotuwaa, wodetuwaanne sunthatuwaa bollan hemettida asaa taariki. He ogetuwaa kaartaa bollan, wodiyaa ogiyan kaalla — itti sohuwaa bochcha, woy ▶ giyaawaa un"ada itti itti aa giddo aad'd'a.
s.ot_lead: Itti buussaa gidennan; shin med'etsaappe doommida atotsaa taarikiyaa gogaa: med'etsaanne kunddetsaa → bashshaa haattaanne Baabeele → xeesaa (Abraahaame) → ufaysetteedda sa'aa → Kessaa → bazzuwaa → xoonuwaa → kawutetsaa → shaaketetsaa → omoodetethaa → simuwaa.
s.je_lead: Wonggalaa mas'aafatuu odiyaawaadan, Yesuusa de'uwaa ogiyan kaalla — Beeteliheemen yelettowaappe doommiide, xammak'ettowaanne Galiilaa oosuwaa baggana, Sammaariyaa pinniide, Yerusaalamen mask'k'aliyaa, denduwaanne pude kesuwaa gakkanaw.
s.pa_lead: Yerusaalamen P'enxxak'osxxeppe doommiide, Wonggalay Yihudaappe kareera waati aakkeeddaakko — Guutta Isiyaanne Awurooppaa baggana kawutetsaa waanna sohuwaa gakkanaw. Ichchashu buussatuwaappe ittuwaa doora (koyro·nam"antsa·heezzantsa + Roome buussaanne + birshshettowaappe guyyiyaa) k'ay ogiyan xaafettida kiitatuwaara Kiitteeddawanttu Oosuwaa hanotatuwaa kaalla.
s.foot: Pulttoti · Sohotuu Geeshsha Mas'aafaa k'aalaanne Geeshsha Mas'aafaa erettida sa'aa eratethaa kaalloosona (maaddiyaa sohuwaan ha"i sunthaara). Abbaa doonaa, shaafatuunne abbatuu dooya sa'aa eratethaappe (Natural Earth) ekettidi, guuxettoosona.

eden.name: Edene (Med'etsaa · Kunddetsaa)
eden.note: Daro lo"o gidiide med'etteedda sa'aakko nagaray geliide, S'oossaanne asaa giddo gaytotetsaa menttee.
events: Koyro Wonggalaa ufaysaa — “mishiraa zeretsay shooshshaa huup'iyaa k'os's'ana”

noah.name: Aaraaraaxe (Bashshaa Haattaa)
noah.today: ha"i Turkiyee arshsho baggaa Aaraaraaxe Deriyaa
noah.note: S'oossay nagaray kumeedda sa'aa pirddee, gidoppe attin itti so'aa baggana de'uwaa ashshee.
events: Zuula caak'k'uwaa — “naa"antsaa bashshaa haattaa mulekka yeddikke”

babel.name: Baabeele Gimbbiyaa
babel.note: Saluwaa gakkanaw koyiyaa ottoruwaa bolli, S'oossay unttunttu doonaanne asaa sa'aa ubbaa bollan laalee.
events: “Katamaanne gimbbiyaa keexxoos… k'ay nu huup'ew sunthaa demmoos”
Asay sa'aa ubbaa bollan laalettee (Shinaare — guyyeppe Baabiloone)

ur.name: Uura
ur.note: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa atotsaa taarikii itti asaa xeesuwaan doommee.
events: “Taani neena gita zaree ootsana… asay ubbay ne baggana anjjettana”

shechem.name: Sekeeme · Kanaane
shechem.note: Ufaysetteedda sa'aan itti so'aa eessettee k'ay caak'k'uu zaretethaa baggana aad'd'ee.
events: Kanaane geliide, koyro yarshsho sohuwaa — “ha sa'aa ne zeretsaw immana”
Yayk'oobe tammanne nam"u naati — tammanne nam"u zaretuwaa xap'uwaa

egypt.name: Gibs'e (Gooshene)
egypt.note: Itti so'aa gita zaree gidee — guyyeppe ayletetteedda zaree.
events: Bayzettowaa Yooseefi Gibs'e haariyaa gakkanaw pude keseedda
Yayk'oobe so'aa ubbay koshaappe attanaw duge woddee

sinai.name: Siinaa Deriyaa
sinai.note: Beni Caak'k'uwaa waanna atotsaa — aylii S'oossaa asa gidee.

kadesh.name: K'aadeesa (bazzuwaa)
kadesh.note: Ammanennatetsay itti yeletsaa sa'aa dhayssee — gidoppe attin S'oossay unttunttunna de'ee.
events: Tammanne nam"u wochanchchatuwaa — shin asay ammananaw ixxee

shiloh.name: Silo (Daannatuwaa)
shiloh.note: Kaatii baynnan, itti itti asay barew likke malateeddawaa c'oo ootsee — tumu kaatii koshshee.
events: Uruuto — d'umaa wodiyan ammanetethaa, Daawita zariyan

jerusalem.name: Yerusaalame · Ittippetteedda Kawutetsaa
jerusalem.note: Israa'eeliyaa work'k'aa wodiyaa — k'ay med'inaa kaatiyaa ufaysaa.
events: Koyro kaatii Saa'oola, guyyeppe Daawitanne Goliyaada

samaria.name: Sammaariyaa · Shaakettowaa Kawutetsaa
events: Solomonappe guyyiyaan, Yihudaanne Israa'eeli giide shaakettee
Eelaasi, Isiyaasi, Ermaasi “simmite” giide waassoosona — k'ay Mase kaseetiide odoosona

nineveh.name: Nanawe (Asoore)
nineveh.note: Seera ubbaa aggibayidi, huuphphe kawutetsay koyro kundee.

babylon.name: Baabiloone
babylon.note: Ubbaappe d'uma k'ammaa — gidoppe attin zaaretethaa ufaysay de'ee.
events: Daaneelanne Hizik'k'eela — omoodetethaa giddon ammanuwaanne ajjuutaa

susa.name: Suusa (Persiyaa)
susa.note: Eek'a kawutetsaa waanna sohuwankka, S'oossay bare asaa naagee.

return.name: Yerusaalame Simuwaa
return.note: Simmiide zaarissi keexxoosona — shin kaatii yiibeenna. Mase naagoosona.
events: K'iiroosa azazuwaan heezzu simuwaa (Zarubaabeela 538 · Izira 458 · Nahimii 444)
Geeshsha Gollii zaaretti keexettee k'ay Yerusaalame dirssay zaarettee
Milkkiyaasi — Beni Caak'k'uu kuuyee: “taani kiittiyaa asaa yeddana”

bethlehem.name: Beeteliheeme
bethlehem.note: Ufaysetteedda Masii Daawita katamaakko yee — K'aalay asho gidee.

nazareth.name: Naazireete
nazareth.note: S'oossay coo katamaan asho gidiide diccee.
events: Tammanne nam"u laytsan, Geeshsha Gollien oychchiidinne zaariide

jordan.name: Yorddaanoosa Shaafaa
jordan.note: Aa k'oncce oosuu doommee — saluu a Na'aa gidiyaawaa markkattee.
events: Ayyaanay holled'd'iyaadan wod'd'ee — “Hawe ta siik'iyaa Na'aa”

cana.name: K'aana
cana.note: Bare koyro malaatan bare bonchchuwaa k'onccissee.
events: Haattay woyniyaa eessaa gidee — bare koyro malaataa

sychar.name: Sikaare (Sammaariyaa)
sychar.note: Koyro oosuwaa ogiyaa — Yerusaalame baggana k'ay karettowaa Sammaariyaakko.

capernaum.name: K'ifirinaahoome
capernaum.note: Galiilaa oosuwaa waanna sohuwaa — xeesuu, tamaarssuunne ixuu ubbay hawaan gaytee.
events: Moliyaa oyk'k'iyaawantta xeesiide hawaa bare waanna sohuwaa ootsee
Kawutetsaa leemisuwaa — k'ay dendishe biyaa ixuwaa

galilee.name: Galiilaa Abbaa
galilee.note: Med'etsaa bollan wolk'k'aa de'iyaawaa I oonakkonne besee.

caesarea_p.name: Pilip'p'oosa K'iisaariyaa
caesarea_p.note: Kaalliyaawantti I Kiristtoosa gidiyaawaa akeekoosona, k'ay mask'k'aliyaa ogii dooyettee.
events: P'eexiroosa markkatetsaa — “Neeni Kiristtoosa, de'o S'oossaa Na'aa”

bethany.name: Biitaaniyaa
bethany.note: Bare wurssetsa saaminttaa sintsan hayk'uwaa bollan wolk'k'aa besee.
events: Ha malaatay a wod'iyaa mak'etsaa mintsee

jerusalem.name: Yerusaalame
jerusalem.book: Maatoossa Mishiraachchuwaa 21–28 · Luuk'aasa Mishiraachchuwaa 24 · Kiitteeddawanttu Oosuwaa 1
jerusalem.note: Geeshsha Mas'aafa ubbay bessiyaa xap'uwaa — mask'k'aliyaa, denduwaa, pude keso.
events: Xoonuwaa geluwaa; Geeshsha Gollii xaraphphezaa gujje aatti yeggee
Heezzantsa gallassan denddiide, guyyeppe pude keseedda

antioch.name: Anxookiyaa
antioch.note: Allaga asaa kiitay doommiyaanne simmiyaa kiittiyaa woosa gollii.
events: Koyro, nam"antsanne heezzantsa buussaa doomiya sohuwaa

seleucia.name: Selewk'iyaa
seleucia.note: Anxookiyaa markkabe wonggaariyaa — K'oproosa baanaw markkabiyan denddoosona.

salamis.name: Salaamiisa (K'oproosa)
salamis.note: K'oproosan koyro ek'k'iyaa sohuwaa — mukuraaben sabbakoosona.

perga.name: Pergge
perga.note: Pampiliyaa markkabe wonggaariyaa — hawaan Yohaannisa Mark'k'oosi guyye simmee.

pantioch.name: Pisiidiyaa Anxookiyaa
events: Daro Allaga asay ufayttiide k'aalaa akkee

iconium.name: Ik'oniyoone
iconium.note: Daroti ammanoosona, shin goodetsay unttuntta sintsaakko yeddee.

lystra.name: Lisxiraa
events: Shuc'aan c'ac'ettidi hayk'k'eedda giide aggin, dendee

derbe.name: Darbbe
derbe.note: Daro kaalliyaawantta ootsoosona; woosa golletuwaa mintsanaw guyye simmoosona.

troas.name: Xiro'aada
troas.note: Wonggalay koyro Awurooppaakko simmiyaa laameta sohuwaa.

philippi.name: Pilip'p'isiyoosa
philippi.note: Awurooppaa koyro woosa gollii — Wonggalay k'asho keettankka xoonee.
events: Giddo k'ammaa mazimuriyaa, biittaa k'aaxxaa, k'asho naagiyaa so'aa atee

thess.name: Tasalonk'e
thess.note: K'aalay katamaa k'aataxxissee k'ay ixuu daree.

berea.name: Berooya
events: Tumakkonne eranaw galla galla Maxaafaa pilggoosona

corinth.name: K'oronttoosa
corinth.note: Itti laytsaanne baggaa uttiide, iita katamaan woosa golliyaa tokkee.

ephesus.name: Efesoona
ephesus.note: Heezzantsa buussaa waanna sohuwaa — k'aalay Isiyaa ubban aakkee.
events: Xiraanoosa golliyan nam"u laytsaa galla galla tamaarssee

miletus.name: Miliixoosa
events: “I bare suuthan shammeedda woosa golliyaa naagite”
Cimatuu a gujje be'ennawaa eriide yeekkoosona

caesarea.name: K'iisaariyaa
caesarea.note: Nam"u laytsaa deriyaa haariyaawanttunne kaatiyaa sintsan Wonggalaa naagee.
events: Deriyaa haariyaa Pilikssanne Piisxxoosa sintsan pirddaa
Kaatii Agriphaa sintsan bare gaasuwaa yootee

jerusalem.name: Yerusaalame
jerusalem.note: Geeshsha Gollien oyk'ettidi, k'asho asadan aa ogii doommee.
events: Roome katamaa asa gidiyaa diraw, naagettidi K'iisaariyaa kiitettee

crete.name: K'arxeese
crete.note: Birshshettowaappe guyyiyaan, woosa golletuwaa giigissanaw Tiito aggi biyaa haruruwaa.
events: Katama ubban cimata sunthanaadan Tiito aggee

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Gotiyaanne markkabe menuwaa giddon, S'oossaa ufaysay ek'ettidi de'ee.
events: “Huuphphe arshsho gotii” markkabiyaa menttee, gidoppe attin 276 ubbay attoosona

rome.name: Roome
rome.note: Wurssettan Wonggalay kawutetsaa waanna sohuwaa gakkee — wurssetsa gidennan, doometsaa.
events: Nam"u laytsaa keettan naagettidi, kawutetsaa xala odiide sabbakee
Guyyeppe gujje k'ashettidi, 2 S'imootoosa xaafee k'ay markka gidiide hayk'k'ee — “Lo"o baaxiyaa baaxetaaddis, gaadiyaa polaaddis”
